description: This file contains localization data and functions for the Spanish (Venezuela) culture for a date manipulation library, likely DateJS. It provides culture-specific information such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates in Spanish (VE), and prototype extensions for date operations.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of the date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local date and time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the current day.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two date objects, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the day number (0-6) from the day name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the month number (0-11) from the month name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines whether the specified year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a specified year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
